title: Retiree asking about HELOC, rep quotes HELOC rate
scenario: Retired couple's husband wants a HELOC as an emergency fund and to help a grandchild with tuition but thinks borrowing costs are too high. The rep gives specific rate and payment numbers.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Good morning, may I speak with Walter?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: This is Walter.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi Walter, this is Anya with Copperleaf Home Loans. You'd asked about a home equity line of credit?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I did. My granddaughter starts college next fall and I'd like a cushion. But I'm not sure. These rates are awful compared to what I'm used to.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: I understand. Is the house paid off?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Paid it off in two thousand fifteen. Proudest day of my life.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Congratulations, that's wonderful. What do you think it's worth now?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Oh, maybe three-fifty. It's a modest place.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: And how much of a line were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Fifty thousand, maybe. I may never touch it.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Okay. Right now our HELOCs are running around eight and a quarter.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Eight and a quarter! When I bought this house it was nine, so I suppose I've seen worse. But still.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: And if you drew the full fifty, interest-only would be roughly three-forty a month.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Hm. Is there a fee just to open it?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: There can be, and it varies with the appraisal and the title work, so let me pull that together properly.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I just think it's a lot of money to pay a bank.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That's fair, and you'd only pay interest on what you use. Are you and your wife both on the title?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: We are. Margaret's in the garden right now.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Got it. Would you like me to mail you a written summary you can look over together?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yes, mail is better. I don't trust email.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Absolutely. I'll send it to the address you listed.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Thank you, young lady.
